description: Multipler composition test (load-bearing single-floor invariant). Cultist has VulnerablePower(2), player has WeakPower(2); player attacks Cultist for 6 raw → composed mul = (3/2) * (3/4) = 9/8 → 6 * 9 / 8 = 54/8 = 6.75 → floor 6. Cultist HP 48 - 6 = 42. Diverges from per-stage flooring (which would give 6→9 vuln→6.75 weak→6, same here, but the audit showed ~12.5% of inputs flip; this fixture documents the canonical multi-multiplier path. A20 sibling (sts2-rs-k3y / sts2-rs-xpa): pins ascension=20 in metadata. Combat-side ascension is identity at python pin 01c094d (see docs/reality-checks/2026-05-12-ascension-audit.md), so the recorded trace is byte-identical to the A0 source except for metadata.ascension.
